framework: NIST incident response and AI risk management

entries.title: GOVERN
entries.relationship: Lifecycle accountability, handling, notifications, and ownership provide inputs to governance; no compliance claim.

entries.title: MAP
entries.relationship: System context, assets, boundaries, affected parties, and harm help contextualize AI risk.

entries.title: MEASURE
entries.relationship: Evidence, observability, Intervention Time, Damage Time, and control performance support measurement.

entries.title: MANAGE
entries.relationship: Containment, severity escalation, corrective action, and revalidation support risk treatment.

entries.identifier: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 / CSF 2.0 Community Profile
entries.title: Cybersecurity incident response
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR timeline, detection, response, containment, recovery, and lessons-learned records can support the community profile; exact organizational outcomes must be assessed separately.
